agent_messages: Skeletonization replaces objects by their isomorphism classes, turning “isomorphic” into literal equality. Thus a thin skeletal category behaves like a poset: arrows both ways force equality, natural isomorphisms of functors are pointwise equalities, and the identity acts trivially on its thin skeleton. Likewise, a fully faithful functor reflects isomorphisms, so it induces an injective map on skeletons.
